Delta r: Difference between the distances from the two sources
L: Length of the measuring line A to B
N: Number of wavelengths between A and B
d: Water depth (in d sin θ, the distance between the slits)
theta: Angle of the line from the +x direction (from straight ahead, for the slits)
theta_1: Angle between the incoming crests and the edge; for one slit, angle of the first quiet line
theta_2: Angle between the crests past the edge and the edge
